Boundary description: Can you say no, and hold your time, emotions, and resources? Typical scenes: being handed extra work at the last minute, being pressed for private details, finding it hard to refuse.
BeingJudged description: How others see you, and how much you fear being rejected. Typical scenes: shame or anger when told you are not good enough; being compared with someone else.
Trust description: Can you rely on them, and do their promises hold? Typical scenes: a promise not kept, being kept in the dark, betrayal.
Expression description: Can you say what you actually need, and can they hear it? Typical scenes: wanting to speak but staying silent, being misunderstood after speaking, talking around the point.
Conflict description: How disagreement gets handled: avoidance, confrontation, compromise, or cooperation. Typical scenes: a cold war after a fight; one side always giving in.
Dependence description: Over-dependence or over-independence, and who takes care of whom. Typical scenes: panic when they do not reply; never daring to ask anyone for help.
Intimacy description: Closeness and being seen: vulnerability, exposure, intimate distance. Typical scenes: wanting to get close but fearing hurt; wanting to run as soon as it gets close.
Authority description: Patterns with parents, bosses, elders, and other power relationships. Typical scenes: not daring to disagree with a boss; habitually pleasing elders.
Boundary source: Sources: Adler's task separation; Cloud & Townsend, Boundaries (1992); Bowen's self-differentiation.
BeingJudged source: Sources: Adler; Cooley's looking-glass self (1902); Sartre's 'Hell is other people' (1944).
Trust source: Sources: Bowlby and Ainsworth's attachment theory; Erikson's trust vs. mistrust (1950).
Expression source: Sources: Rosenberg's Nonviolent Communication (1999); Rogers' unconditional positive regard.
Conflict source: Sources: Thomas-Kilmann conflict modes (1974); Fisher and Ury, Getting to Yes (1981).
Dependence source: Sources: attachment theory; Horney's moving toward people (1945); Beattie on codependency (1986).
Intimacy source: Sources: Erikson's intimacy vs. isolation (1950); Sue Johnson's EFT; Brene Brown, Daring Greatly (2012).
Authority source: Sources: Adler; Berne's transactional analysis (1961); Milgram (1963); Alice Miller (1979).
